color.note: Dark is the brand default. Always reference the rt-* names, never raw hex. Light-theme signal colours and rt-border-control are additions to the brand source.

tokens.name: rt-bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Void in dark, white in light. Text and accents on it: rt-text, rt-text-muted, rt-accent.

tokens.name: rt-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, nav bars and sections raised from rt-bg. Same text tokens as rt-bg.

tokens.name: rt-surface-2
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags and nested panels on rt-surface. Same text tokens as rt-bg.

tokens.name: rt-text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on rt-bg, rt-surface and rt-surface-2 (17.4:1 to 14.5:1 dark, 18.3:1 to 16.2:1 light).

tokens.name: rt-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on rt-bg, rt-surface and rt-surface-2 (7.6:1 or more dark, 5.5:1 or more light).

tokens.name: rt-accent
tokens.usage: Signal colour: CTAs, links, focus ring, the diamond bullet. Vision Gold in dark, Deep Gold in light. 8.9:1 dark, 5.2:1 light on all surfaces.

tokens.name: rt-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a rt-accent fill: navy on gold (9.8:1), white on deep gold (5.9:1).

tokens.name: rt-border
tokens.usage: Hairline for cards, dividers and column lines. Decorative only, so never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: rt-border-control
tokens.usage: Edge of inputs and outline buttons (4.5:1 dark, 3.2:1 light on rt-surface-2). Added to this system so controls meet 3:1.

tokens.name: rt-vision-gold
tokens.usage: Brand gold. The mark, CTAs, highlights, about 6% of any layout. Not for text on white (1.9:1).

tokens.name: rt-midnight-navy
tokens.usage: Brand surface (about 22%). Inherited from Ruyat Al Enjaz. Text colour on light backgrounds.

tokens.name: rt-void
tokens.usage: Primary dark background (about 60%): the space the light sits in.

tokens.name: rt-deep-gold
tokens.usage: Gold for light backgrounds and small text. The mark and Tech in the wordmark on light.

tokens.name: rt-frost
tokens.usage: Cool off-white for text on dark and for light surfaces. Never pure grey.

tokens.name: rt-lumen
tokens.usage: Highlight end of the gold edge gradient and the horizon arc. Never a large fill.

tokens.name: rt-gold-50
tokens.usage: Gold scale step 50. Use for tints, hover and pressed states and charts; pick text pairs that reach 4.5:1.

tokens.usage: Gold scale step 100. Use for tints, hover and pressed states and charts; pick text pairs that reach 4.5:1.

tokens.name: rt-signal-success
tokens.usage: Success text, icons and badges on rt-bg, rt-surface and rt-surface-2. Dark value from the brand; light value added for 4.5:1 on white. Always pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: rt-signal-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text, icons and badges on rt-bg, rt-surface and rt-surface-2. Dark value from the brand; light value added. Always pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: rt-signal-error
tokens.usage: Error text, icons and badges on rt-bg, rt-surface and rt-surface-2. Dark value from the brand; light value added. Always pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: rt-signal-info
tokens.usage: Info text, icons and badges on rt-bg, rt-surface and rt-surface-2. Dark value from the brand; light value added. Always pair with a word or icon.

styles.name: rt-label

tokens.name: rt-shadow-elev-1

duration.note: Soft, easy, unhurried. Fast to respond, slow to settle.

tokens.usage: Colour and focus changes, press.

tokens.name: rt-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and toggles.

tokens.name: rt-base
tokens.usage: Menus, tabs and cards.

tokens.name: rt-slow

tokens.name: rt-ambient

tokens.name: rt-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between siblings, up to 6.

tokens.name: rt-ease-out
